SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) as sum_yt, COUNT(*) as n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 30 AND 61
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT fish_date_doy - 75 as diff, cls, yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 65 AND 85
ORDER BY fish_date_season DESC, fish_date_doy
LIMIT 100

SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls, SUM(yt) as sum_yt, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 0 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 55 AND 110
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls
HAVING SUM(yt) > 0
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
